utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, just point me to where I should bring the stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. Bring it by the community shed on Maple after 4, and I’ll sort it from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — community shed on Maple after 4. I’ll drop it off then, and if I forget, I’ll blame my old brain instead of the screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed a few details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah — we’re just gathering any small broken items people want fixed, then we’ll sort them and hand them off to the repair crew. If you can help spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can do that. I’ll mention it around the block and send anyone with small broken stuff your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Uli, what time should I bring the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 9 would be best, if that works for you. धन्यवाद... I mean, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll bring them around 9. Anything else you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — you should come by, Opal! I’ll send the details around so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — send me the details and I’ll keep an eye out for the location and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the location and time as soon as I have them, and I’ll make sure you’re on the list!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Hana — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam. I’m checking the details first—what can you take on for the repair drive, and what should I tell you about the deadline?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with sorting donations, moving supplies, or making a quick pickup run. Just let me know the deadline, where to bring everything, and any timing details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a basic toolbox, some duct tape, and a few spare screws? If you have work gloves too, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring the toolbox, duct tape, spare screws, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can use your help. Do you want to handle the sign-up list or the supply drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can handle the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — that’s a big help. I’ll send you the sign-up sheet, and we can keep the supplies moving separately.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the pickup and drop-off times are clear so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely—let’s keep it simple: I can do pickup at 9 and drop-off by 3, and I’ll write it down so it’s clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me, as long as the address and contact number are written down too. I just want to avoid any confusion on the day.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so could you tell folks we need volunteers, tools, and any spare parts people can donate?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks we need volunteers, tools, and any spare parts they can spare. I’ll mention it while I’m out running errands, too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little stock set aside for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—what exactly do you still need me to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just the final list of items and how many you can bring, so I can match it against what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I can lend a hand and any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’s a huge help. I’ll bring the list and we can figure out what tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring the list over, and I’ll see what I’ve got in the shed we can use.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule for the repair drive—what day and time are you aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a huge help—I'm thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9 or 10, so folks can come by before the day gets away from them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works on my end—I can help keep it to the 9 to 10 window and make sure it doesn’t clash with school stuff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that around school pickup, just tell me when the repair drive is and what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning for the repair drive, and I mainly need help spreading the word and keeping an eye on check-in. I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work well for me, and I can help spread the word and cover check-in. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll fit it around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, how are the repair drive plans coming along?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first so we don’t miss anything—do you want me to confirm the supplies, volunteers, or timing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please confirm the supplies first, then the volunteers. We can check the timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on—same place, same time as planned. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll keep it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m setting up the repair drive details now, and I’ll make sure Cleo has everything she needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — please let me know what supplies you still need and I’ll keep track of them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send you a simple supply list shortly, and I’ll flag any gaps as I finalize the drive details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, Leo. Just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — could you help sort donations and label the boxes? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll sort the donations and label the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve just heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I know folks are still gathering tools and volunteers. I can check back and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren—that’d be great. I’m mostly just trying to keep up with whatever’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the details and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll get you the repair drive details and send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m in for the repair drive and happy to help where needed. What’s the first thing you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you start by checking which tools and supplies we already have, and make a quick list of anything still needed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’ve already got and make a quick needs list. I’ll report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive, and I can swing by to spread the word more if you want.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Quinn — thanks. If you can, just point folks to the sign-up sheet and the donation box at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll send folks straight to the sign-up sheet and donation box at the community center. I’ll keep spreading the word today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — I’m keeping track of where the repair drive stops, so I just need the pickup location, the time, and what items you’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help at Maple Street Community Hall at 6:30, and I’ll bring a box of screws, a tape measure, and some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We just need to head to the repair drive drop-off at the community center parking lot and bring any broken small appliances or tools you’ve set aside.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll gather any broken small appliances or tools and head to the community center parking lot drop-off. If I forget, feel free to nudge me again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Quinn — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Sam — could you start by checking which houses still need repair sign-ups and jotting down any urgent fixes? Once you’ve got that, bring it to me and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check which houses still need sign-ups and note any urgent fixes, then bring the list right over to you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Happy to help—what needs fixing, and where should I drop off the parts?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks Leo — it’s just the loose fence panel by the back gate and a squeaky porch hinge. You can drop the parts on my front step anytime today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll drop the parts on your front step today and can take a look at the fence panel after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting some good momentum—if you want, I can swing by and bring anything over while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be wonderful, Ira — thank you. I’ll send you a quick list of what still needs moving, and we can keep the drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Rosa—send it over and I’ll grab what I can on my way back. Glad to help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m glad we’re doing it; I can help sort things or carry stuff if you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you come by Saturday morning and help sort the donations?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, Saturday morning works for me. I’ll come by and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I heard the repair drive is this week? If you’ve got the details, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I think so, but I’m not sure yet—can you confirm the day and time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the exact day or time yet either—just the rumor that it’s sometime this week. If you hear anything solid, can you pass it along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli — I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. Want me to help spread the word or line up volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules — let’s spread the word first, then line up volunteers after that. I like having one clear step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word first and keep it simple. I’ll check back with a few people and then we can line up volunteers next.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I can lend a hand with the repair drive—got a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, Gus — I could use that. I’m still figuring out what’s needed, but I’ll swing by when I know more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know what you need, and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I’m a bit late—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries — could you help with the repair drive sign-up list and make sure we’ve got the pickup times set around school dismissal?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll take the sign-up list and line up pickup times around dismissal. I’ll check back with you once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—let me check the list first so I don’t miss anything. I’ll tell you exactly what still needs fixing in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, take your time—I’m here when you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That makes sense — I’m still confirming the drop-off spot, but I should have the timing and location for you soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — just let me know as soon as you have it, and I’ll fit it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll bring it up with a few neighbors and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Vik — thank you. I’ll get the details ready, and we can compare notes once you’ve spoken with them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll talk to a few folks this afternoon and let you know what I hear. Then we can compare notes and line up the next step.
